traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements from docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified by tests.
- Core functionality: The valid-story-reference rule parses @story annotations, resolves paths relative to context.cwd/process.cwd with configured storyDirectories, enforces .story.md extension (when requireStoryExtension is true), and checks existence using cached filesystem operations. Missing, invalid-extension, and invalid-path cases all produce specific diagnostics. - Quality standards & integration: Implementation follows ESLint Rule.Module patterns, uses a RuleTester-based suite plus additional Jest tests around helpers and utilities, and integrates cleanly with prior annotation format validation (it assumes already well-formed @story lines and focuses on file resolution/existence). - User experience & error handling: Message texts are clear and contextual; tests assert messageIds and data payloads. Filesystem errors (permission, I/O) are caught, converted into fs-error statuses, and surfaced via fileAccessError diagnostics instead of throwing, satisfying the robustness requirements. - Security & project boundaries: Absolute paths, traversal, and misconfigured storyDirectories are checked and rejected when they would escape project root, with behavior verified by dedicated tests. - Configurability & performance: storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, and requireStoryExtension options are supported and tested; filesystem existence checks are cached per process with a reset hook for tests.
Given the concrete implementation and the passing, story-specific tests, this story is fully implemented and passes all its acceptance criteria.
